field.area_note: representative pivot area; use drawn boundary in production

satellite_ndvi.source: Sentinel-2 NDVI composite (proxy recovered from colour ramp; production uses raw B4/B8: NDVI=(B8-B4)/(B8+B4))
satellite_ndvi.idle_land_note: scene-level bare/fallow share (fully-tan pivots + harvested sectors); per-field idle area needs the field boundary

waste_estimate.method: gross applied = net demand / irrigation efficiency
waste_estimate.label: ESTIMATE — no field flow-meter; efficiency figure indicative

ag_share_water.text: Agriculture = 84% of KSA total water requirements; non-renewable groundwater = 90% of water supplied to agriculture.
ag_share_water.source: Ministry of Environment, Water & Agriculture (MEWA), Water Agency.

ag_water_volume_2023.text: Agriculture used 12,298 million m3 in 2023 (largest consumer); non-renewable groundwater use 9,356 million m3 (-7% vs 2022).

irrigation_efficiency.text: Irrigation often ~50% efficient vs ~85% global best practice (indicative, non-official — flag as unverified).
irrigation_efficiency.source: FEWS NET, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia country page.

ndvi_kc.text: NDVI->Kcb via fraction-of-cover (SIMS); Kcb_full=1.10, NDVI_min=0.15, NDVI_max=0.90.
ndvi_kc.source: Allen & Pereira (2009); Calera et al. (2017); FAO-56.

et0.text: ET0 = FAO-56 Penman-Monteith from NASA POWER daily reanalysis meteorology (observational, NOT a forecast).
et0.source: Allen et al. (1998) FAO-56; NASA POWER (power.larc.nasa.gov).
